label: V6.4.137 - DESKTOP GHOST CLEANUP
notes: Desktop My Flight ghost-control cleanup. The legacy close button is removed from the DOM instead of being visually hidden, and the global context-back injector is disabled for desktop My Flight so it cannot create an extra faded navigation control. Header navigation is now exactly the stable previous-page arrow plus MENU. Mobile behavior and the V6.4.135 form-open performance path are unchanged.
message: V6.4.137: gỡ hẳn nút mờ/legacy trên MY FLIGHT PC; header chỉ còn mũi tên và MENU.
